control: wrong fact (CED 1.5.A.2: a polynomial function of degree n has exactly n COMPLEX zeros counting multiplicities, not n real zeros)
title: Number of zeros of a polynomial function
body: A polynomial function of degree n has exactly n real zeros when counting multiplicities.
ced_evidence: 1.5.A.2: "A polynomial function of degree n has exactly n complex zeros when counting multiplicities."

control: non-CED content (synthetic division and the rational root theorem appear nowhere in the AP Precalculus CED; the CED names only polynomial long division at 1.11.B.1)
title: Synthetic division and the rational root theorem
body: Use synthetic division to test each candidate from the rational root theorem, p/q where p divides the constant term and q divides the leading coefficient, to find the zeros of a polynomial.

control: wrong owner topic (vertical asymptotes of rational functions are topic 1.9, EK 1.9.A.1; 1.7 covers end behavior of rational functions)
title: Vertical asymptote of a rational function
body: If a is a real zero of the denominator and is not also a real zero of the numerator, the graph of the rational function has a vertical asymptote at x = a.

control: swapped conditions (CED 1.7.A.5: when the DENOMINATOR dominates, the graph has a horizontal asymptote at y = 0; 1.7.A.3: when the numerator dominates, the function takes the end behavior of that polynomial)
title: End behavior of a rational function by dominance
body: Which polynomial dominates determines the end behavior of the rational function.

items.label: Numerator dominates
items.meaning: the graph has a horizontal asymptote at y = 0

items.label: Neither dominates
items.meaning: the quotient of the leading terms is a constant, which locates a horizontal asymptote

items.label: Denominator dominates
items.meaning: the quotient of the leading terms is a nonconstant polynomial and the function has that polynomial's end behavior

control: hook expansion contradicts the CED (1.10.A.1: a hole occurs when the numerator multiplicity is greater than or equal to the denominator's; 1.9.A.1: a vertical asymptote occurs when the denominator multiplicity is greater). The hook reverses this. The entry is correct, so only the hook should be rejected.
title: Hole versus vertical asymptote at a shared zero
body: If the multiplicity of a real zero in the numerator is greater than or equal to its multiplicity in the denominator, the graph has a hole at that input value; a vertical asymptote occurs instead when the multiplicity in the denominator is greater.

expands_to.means: so the graph has a hole at that input value

hooks.when_to_use: when deciding between a hole and a vertical asymptote
hooks.caution: State the multiplicity comparison in CED terms when answering.
